symbols.name: ACTIVE
symbols.summary: Objects running a script or physically moving (using server resources). In llDetectedType(), it identifies physical objects and agents. In llSensor() or llSensorRepeat(), it searches for moving physical objects or scripted objects.

symbols.name: AGENT
symbols.summary: Agents (avatars). In llDetectedType, it indicates an avatar. In llSensor or llSensorRepeat, it searches for avatars by legacy name (functionally identical to AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, though using AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME is recommended instead).

symbols.name: AGENT_ALWAYS_RUN
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar has 'Always Run' enabled or is using tap-tap-hold.

symbols.name: AGENT_ATTACHMENTS
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar has attachments.

symbols.name: AGENT_AUTOMATED
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to identify if the avatar is registered with Linden Lab as an automated/scripted agent (bot).

symbols.name: AGENT_AUTOPILOT
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in autopilot mode, which is enabled when the user selects 'Go Here' on the ground or uses double-click autopilot.

symbols.name: AGENT_AWAY
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in 'away' mode, which indicates they toggled away or have been inactive for too long.

symbols.name: AGENT_BUSY
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in 'busy' mode.

symbols.name: AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME
symbols.summary: Used to find agents by legacy name. In llDetectedType, it indicates an avatar. In llSensor or llSensorRepeat, it searches for avatars by legacy name.

symbols.name: AGENT_BY_USERNAME
symbols.summary: Used to find agents by username (see Avatar Names).

symbols.name: AGENT_CROUCHING
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is crouching.

symbols.name: AGENT_FLOATING_VIA_SCRIPTED_ATTACHMENT
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is floating or hovering because of a scripted attachment using either llSetHoverHeight or llGroundRepel.

symbols.name: AGENT_FLYING
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar is flying or hovering.

symbols.name: AGENT_IN_AIR
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in the air (jumping, flying, or falling).

symbols.name: AGENT_LIST_PARCEL
symbols.summary: Agents on the same parcel where the script is running.

symbols.name: AGENT_LIST_PARCEL_OWNER
symbols.summary: Agents on any parcel in the region where the parcel owner is the same as the owner of the parcel under the scripted object.

symbols.name: AGENT_LIST_REGION
symbols.summary: Returns any or all agents in the region.

symbols.name: AGENT_MOUSELOOK
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in mouselook.

symbols.name: AGENT_ON_OBJECT
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is sitting on an object and linked to it.

symbols.name: AGENT_SCRIPTED
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is carrying scripted objects or has scripted attachments.

symbols.name: AGENT_SITTING
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is sitting.

symbols.name: AGENT_TYPING
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is typing.

symbols.name: AGENT_WALKING
symbols.summary: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar is walking, running, or crouch walking.

symbols.name: ANIM_ON

symbols.name: BEACON_MAP
symbols.summary: Causes llMapBeacon to optionally display and focus the world map on the avatar's viewer.

symbols.name: CAMERA_ACTIVE
symbols.summary: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to turn scripted control of the camera on or off.

symbols.name: CAMERA_BEHINDNESS_ANGLE
symbols.summary: Sets the angle in degrees within which the camera is not constrained by changes in target rotation.

symbols.name: CAMERA_BEHINDNESS_LAG
symbols.summary: Sets how strongly the camera is forced to stay behind the target if outside of the behindness angle.

symbols.name: CAMERA_DISTANCE
symbols.summary: Sets how far away the camera wants to be from its target.

symbols.name: CAMERA_FOCUS
symbols.summary: Sets camera focus (target position) in region coordinates.

symbols.name: CAMERA_FOCUS_LAG
symbols.summary: Sets how much the camera lags as it aims toward the target.

symbols.name: CAMERA_FOCUS_LOCKED
symbols.summary: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to lock the camera focus so it does not move.

symbols.name: CAMERA_FOCUS_OFFSET
symbols.summary: Adjusts the camera focus position relative to the target.

symbols.name: CAMERA_FOCUS_THRESHOLD
symbols.summary: Sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's target position within which its focus is not affected by target motion.

symbols.name: CAMERA_PITCH
symbols.summary: Adjusts the angular amount that the camera aims straight ahead versus straight down, maintaining the same distance (analogous to 'incidence').

symbols.name: CAMERA_POSITION
symbols.summary: Sets camera position in region coordinates.

symbols.name: CAMERA_POSITION_LAG
symbols.summary: Sets how much the camera lags as it moves toward its ideal position.

symbols.name: CAMERA_POSITION_LOCKED
symbols.summary: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to lock the camera position so it does not move.

symbols.name: CAMERA_POSITION_THRESHOLD
symbols.summary: Sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's ideal position within which it is not affected by target motion.

symbols.name: CHANGED_ALLOWED_DROP
symbols.summary: Object inventory changed because a user other than the owner (or the owner if the object is no-mod) added an item. This is only possible if enabled via llAllowInventoryDrop.

symbols.name: CHANGED_COLOR
symbols.summary: Object's Blinn-Phong color or alpha parameters have changed.

symbols.name: CHANGED_INVENTORY
symbols.summary: Prim inventory has changed by someone who has modification rights to it.

symbols.name: CHANGED_LINK
symbols.summary: Number of prims making up the object or avatars seated on it has changed. Also occurs when duplicating a linked object or when a prim changes type or shape. Does not trigger on attach/detach, sit/unsit in attachments, or single prim duplication.

symbols.name: CHANGED_MEDIA
symbols.summary: Prim Media on the prim has changed.

symbols.name: CHANGED_OWNER
symbols.summary: Object has changed owners. Triggers in the original object when a user takes it, copies it, or deeds it to a group, and in the new object when it is first rezzed.

symbols.name: CHANGED_REGION
symbols.summary: Object has changed regions by crossing a boundary or teleporting (if attached). Triggers only in the root prim of a linkset.

symbols.name: CHANGED_REGION_START
symbols.summary: Region containing this object has just come online.

symbols.name: CHANGED_RENDER_MATERIAL
symbols.summary: Render material (prim material ID or material overrides) has changed on one or more faces.

symbols.name: CHANGED_SCALE
symbols.summary: Prim scale of at least one prim in the linked object has changed. Only the root prim receives this event.

symbols.name: CHANGED_SHAPE
symbols.summary: Prim base shape (PRIM_TYPE, such as box, prism, torus, taper, twist, or cut) has changed.

symbols.name: CHANGED_TELEPORT
symbols.summary: Avatar this object is attached to has teleported. Triggers only in the root prim of an attachment. Does not occur for child prims or 'sit teleports'. If scripts are disabled at the destination, the event queues and triggers after moving to a script-enabled parcel.

symbols.name: CHANGED_TEXTURE
symbols.summary: Prim texture parameters (shine/bump settings, repeats, flip, rotation, offset, or texture) have changed.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_ACCOUNT_FOR_SKIPPED_FRAMES
symbols.summary: If set to FALSE, the pathfinding character will not attempt to catch up on lost time when performance is low, potentially providing more reliable (though potentially more stuttery) movement. Default is TRUE.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_AVOIDANCE_MODE
symbols.summary: Specifies which objects a pathfinding character avoids (other characters, dynamic obstacles like fast-moving objects and avatars, or both). Combined using bit flags; setting to AVOID_NONE disables avoidance for both categories.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_CMD_JUMP
symbols.summary: Makes the character jump. Requires a height parameter between 0.1m and 2.0m as the first element of the llExecCharacterCmd option list.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_CMD_SMOOTH_STOP
symbols.summary: Stops any current pathfinding operation in a smooth fashion.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_CMD_STOP
symbols.summary: Stops any current pathfinding operation.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_DESIRED_SPEED
symbols.summary: Constant used to indicate that the following argument is the desired speed (or speed of pursuit in meters per second) for a pathfinding character.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_DESIRED_TURN_SPEED
symbols.summary: Specifies the character's maximum speed while turning about the Z-axis (default is 6 meters/second). Note that this is only loosely enforced, and a character may turn at higher speeds under certain conditions.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_LENGTH
symbols.summary: Sets the collision capsule length for a pathfinding character. If the value is less than twice the radius plus 0.1m, it automatically adjusts to twice the radius plus 0.1m.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_MAX_ACCEL
symbols.summary: Specifies the character's maximum acceleration rate (default is 20 m/s²).

symbols.name: CHARACTER_MAX_DECEL
symbols.summary: Specifies the character's maximum deceleration rate (default is 30 m/s²).

symbols.name: CHARACTER_MAX_SPEED
symbols.summary: Specifies the character's maximum speed (must be between 0.2 and 50 meters/second; default is 20 m/s). Affects speed when avoiding dynamic obstacles and when traversing low-walkability objects in TRAVERSAL_TYPE_FAST mode.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_MAX_TURN_RADIUS
symbols.summary: Specifies the character's turn radius when traveling at CHARACTER_DESIRED_TURN_SPEED (default is 1.25 meters).

symbols.name: CHARACTER_ORIENTATION
symbols.summary: Specifies the orientation of the collision capsule for a pathfinding character to denote how to interpret its size. Valid options are VERTICAL and HORIZONTAL.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_RADIUS
symbols.summary: Sets the collision capsule radius used to define the size of a pathfinding character.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_STAY_WITHIN_PARCEL
symbols.summary: Determines whether a character is restricted to its starting parcel (default is FALSE). If TRUE, parcel boundaries act as one-way obstacles; the character cannot voluntarily leave and pathfinding behaviors (wander, flee, evade, pursue) will only choose goal points within the parcel. If pushed out, it can re-enter but cannot voluntarily leave again.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_TYPE
symbols.summary: Specifies the preferred surface and terrain terrain-type for the character (default is CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE). Used to describe preferred surfaces rather than behavior (e.g., cows prefer type B, sheep herded along a road prefer type C).

symbols.name: CHARACTER_TYPE_A
symbols.summary: Used for pathfinding character types that prefer movement consistent with humanoids.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_TYPE_B
symbols.summary: Used for pathfinding character types that prefer movement consistent with wild animals or off-road vehicles.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_TYPE_C
symbols.summary: Used for mechanical pathfinding character types or road-going vehicles.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_TYPE_D
symbols.summary: Used for pathfinding character types that are inconsistent with types A, B, or C.

symbols.name: CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE
symbols.summary: Used to set no specific pathfinding character type.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_BUY
symbols.summary: Opens the buy dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_DISABLED
symbols.summary: Disables click actions. No touches are detected or passed.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_IGNORE
symbols.summary: Disables click actions. Clicks pass through the object to whatever is behind it, and no touches are detected.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_NONE
symbols.summary: Performs the default action: triggers touch events when the prim is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_OPEN
symbols.summary: Opens the object inventory dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_OPEN_MEDIA
symbols.summary: Opens the web media dialog or plays parcel media (without pausing) when the prim is touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_PAY
symbols.summary: Opens the pay dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_PLAY
symbols.summary: Enables HTML-on-a-prim or plays/pauses parcel media when the prim is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_SIT
symbols.summary: Causes the avatar to sit on the prim when it is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_TOUCH
symbols.summary: Triggers touch events when the prim is clicked or touched.

symbols.name: CLICK_ACTION_ZOOM
symbols.summary: Zooms the avatar camera in on the object (Viewer 2) when clicked or touched.

symbols.name: COMBAT_CHANNEL
symbols.summary: A region-wide channel reserved for combat-related log events. Passing this to llRegionSay adds the message to the combat log, and scripts listening on this channel can monitor the combat log.

symbols.name: COMBAT_LOG_ID
symbols.summary: ID used by all combat log messages sent from the region to the COMBAT_CHANNEL. Scripts can filter llListen calls with this ID to receive only system-generated combat log messages.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_ATOM
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/atom+xml'.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_FORM
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_HTML
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'text/html'. Only valid for embedded browsers on content owned by the viewer; falls back to 'text/plain' otherwise.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_JSON
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/json'.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_LLSD
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/llsd+xml' (Linden Lab Structured Data).

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_RSS
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/rss+xml'.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_TEXT
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'text/plain'.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_XHTML
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/xhtml+xml'.

symbols.name: CONTENT_TYPE_XML
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/xml'.

symbols.name: CONTROL_BACK
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar move back control (↓ or S).

symbols.name: CONTROL_DOWN
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar move down control (PgDn or C).

symbols.name: CONTROL_FWD

symbols.name: CONTROL_LBUTTON
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar left mouse button control.

symbols.name: CONTROL_LEFT
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar move left control (Shift + ← or Shift + A).

symbols.name: CONTROL_ML_LBUTTON
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar left mouse button control while in mouselook.

symbols.name: CONTROL_RIGHT

symbols.name: CONTROL_ROT_LEFT
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar rotate left control (← or A).

symbols.name: CONTROL_ROT_RIGHT
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar rotate right control (→ or D).

symbols.name: CONTROL_UP
symbols.summary: Tests for the avatar move up control (PgUp or E).

symbols.name: DAMAGEABLE
symbols.summary: Identifies objects in the world that can process damage. In llDetectedType, it indicates a damageable agent, or an object containing a script with on_damage or final_damage events. Can also filter llSensor/llSensorRepeat calls.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_ACID
symbols.summary: Damage caused by a caustic substance, such as acid.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_BLUDGEONING
symbols.summary: Damage caused by a blunt object, such as a club.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_COLD
symbols.summary: Damage inflicted by exposure to extreme cold.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_ELECTRIC
symbols.summary: Damage caused by electricity.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_EMOTIONAL
symbols.summary: Official LSL constant: DAMAGE_TYPE_EMOTIONAL.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_FIRE
symbols.summary: Damage inflicted by exposure to heat or flames.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_FORCE
symbols.summary: Damage inflicted by a great force or impact (Vertical Sim / SLMC).

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_GENERIC
symbols.summary: Generic or legacy damage.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_IMPACT
symbols.summary: System damage generated by impact with land, terrain, or a prim.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_NECROTIC
symbols.summary: Damage caused by a direct assault on the life-force.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_PIERCING
symbols.summary: Damage caused by a piercing object such as a bullet, spear, or arrow (Vertical Sim / SLMC).

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_POISON
symbols.summary: Damage caused by poison.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_PSYCHIC
symbols.summary: Damage caused by a direct assault on the mind.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_RADIANT
symbols.summary: Damage caused by radiation or extreme light.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_SLASHING
symbols.summary: Damage caused by a slashing object such as a sword or axe.

symbols.name: DAMAGE_TYPE_SONIC
symbols.summary: Damage caused by loud noises, like a Crash Worship concert.

symbols.name: DATA_BORN
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestAgentData to return the agent's account creation ('born on') date as a string in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), based on Pacific Time (not UTC).

symbols.name: DATA_NAME
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestAgentData to return the requested agent's legacy name.

symbols.name: DATA_ONLINE
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestAgentData to return whether the requested agent is online (returns an integer boolean string: TRUE if online, FALSE if offline).

symbols.name: DATA_PAYINFO
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestAgentData to return a string containing the integer mask flag for payment status (contains PAYMENT_INFO_ON_FILE, PAYMENT_INFO_USED, or both).

symbols.name: DATA_RATING
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Used with llRequestAgentData to return the string '0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'. It formerly returned a comma-separated list of positive and negative ratings (behavior, appearance, and building) before ratings were removed from SL.

symbols.name: DATA_RESERVED_0
symbols.summary: Reserved for Linden use.

symbols.name: DATA_SIM_POS
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the region's global position as a vector.

symbols.name: DATA_SIM_RATING
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the simulator rating string ('PG', 'MATURE', 'ADULT', or 'UNKNOWN').

symbols.name: DATA_SIM_STATUS
symbols.summary: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the simulator status as a string.

symbols.name: DEBUG_CHANNEL
symbols.summary: A chat channel reserved for script debugging and error messages. Passing this to llSay, llWhisper, or llShout prints text to the Script Warning/Error Window and broadcasts it to nearby avatars' script consoles.

symbols.name: DEG_TO_RAD
symbols.summary: Constant 0.017453293 (precise value is PI/180). Multiply a value in degrees by this number to convert it to radians.

symbols.name: DENSITY
symbols.summary: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to indicate that the density parameter is enabled (which overrides the previous value). Must be between 1.0 and 22587.0 kg/m³.

symbols.name: DEREZ_DIE
symbols.summary: Used with llDerezObject to immediately delete (kill) the object.

symbols.name: DEREZ_MAKE_TEMP
symbols.summary: Used with llDerezObject to mark the object as temporary, allowing the simulator to clean it up at a later time.

symbols.name: DEREZ_TO_INVENTORY
symbols.summary: Used with llDerezObject to return the targeted object to the rezzer's (derezzer's) inventory, saving its current state.

symbols.name: ENVIRONMENT_DAYINFO
symbols.summary: Day cycle and time information: day_length (seconds in the environment's day cycle), day_offset (seconds offset from GMT), and secs_since_midnight (seconds elapsed since the last day cycle midnight).

symbols.name: ENV_INVALID_AGENT
symbols.summary: Unable to find the specified agent, or could not find an agent with the specified ID.

symbols.name: ENV_INVALID_RULE

symbols.name: LINK_ALL_OTHERS
symbols.summary: Refers to every other prim in the linkset, excluding the prim containing the script.

symbols.name: LINK_ROOT

symbols.name: LINK_SET
symbols.summary: Refers to every prim in the linkset.

symbols.name: LINK_THIS
symbols.summary: Refers specifically to the single prim containing the running script.

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_GEOMETRIC_MEAN
symbols.summary: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the geometric mean of a list of numbers.

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_MAX
symbols.summary: Option used with llListStatistics to find the largest number in the list.

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_MEAN

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_MEDIAN

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_MIN

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_NUM_COUNT

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_RANGE

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_STD_DEV

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_SUM

symbols.name: LIST_STAT_SUM_SQUARES

symbols.name: LOOP
symbols.summary: Used with texture animation functions to cause the animation to loop continuously.

symbols.name: MASK_BASE
symbols.summary: Permissions mask option representing base permissions.

symbols.name: MASK_COMBINED
symbols.summary: Permissions mask option to include the object's inventory contents when calculating permissions. Can be combined with other mask flags (e.g., MASK_OWNER | MASK_COMBINED).

symbols.name: MASK_EVERYONE
symbols.summary: Permissions mask option representing permissions held by everyone.

symbols.name: MASK_GROUP
symbols.summary: Permissions mask option representing active group permissions.

symbols.name: MASK_NEXT
symbols.summary: Permissions mask option representing permissions the next owner will inherit.

symbols.name: MASK_OWNER
symbols.summary: Permissions mask option representing current owner permissions.

symbols.name: NAK
symbols.summary: Value returned by llGetNotecardLineSync and llFindNotecardTextSync (as a single-entry list) when the notecard is not in the region's cache. Equal to an ASCII NAK surrounded by newlines (codes 10, 21, 10).

symbols.name: NULL_KEY
symbols.summary: A special string constant used as a null or empty key value.

symbols.name: OBJECT_ACCOUNT_LEVEL
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve an avatar's account level. Returns 0 for Basic, 1 for Premium, 5 for Plus, 10 for Premium Plus, or -1 if the target is not an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_ANIMATED_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails. For an object, returns a boolean indicating if the root is set as 'Animated Mesh'. For an agent, returns the total number of 'Animated Mesh' attachments worn.

symbols.name: OBJECT_ANIMATED_SLOTS_AVAILABLE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the avatar's available 'Animated Mesh' attachment slot count (returns 0 if the ID is not an avatar).

symbols.name: OBJECT_ATTACHED_POINT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails. Returns the integer attachment point matching an ATTACH_* constant, or 0 if the target is not an attachment (e.g., an avatar or unattached object).

symbols.name: OBJECT_ATTACHED_SLOTS_AVAILABLE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get an avatar's available attachment slot count. Returns 0 if the ID is not an avatar or if no slots are available.

symbols.name: OBJECT_BODY_SHAPE_TYPE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve a float representing the gender/sex setting of an avatar's shape (0.0 is standard female, 1.0 is standard male, and values greater than or equal to 0.5 are considered male). Returns -1.0 if not an avatar or if no data is available.

symbols.name: OBJECT_CHARACTER_TIME
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the average CPU time (in seconds) spent on navigation if the target is a pathfinding character. Returns 0 for non-characters.

symbols.name: OBJECT_CLICK_ACTION
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the click action of a prim. Returns an integer corresponding to a CLICK_ACTION_* constant (default is 0).

symbols.name: OBJECT_CREATION_TIME
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the object's creation time (established via build-menu rezzing or mesh uploads, not via inventory/script rezzes, copying, or modifying). Returns an empty string for avatars.

symbols.name: OBJECT_CREATOR
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the key of the prim's creator. Returns NULL_KEY if the ID is an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_DAMAGE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the amount of damage a prim inflicts upon collision.

symbols.name: OBJECT_DAMAGE_TYPE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the type of damage a prim inflicts on collision. Returns an integer matching a DAMAGE_TYPE_* constant, a custom type, or a value repurposed by a combat system.

symbols.name: OBJECT_DESC
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the prim's description. Returns an empty string if the ID is an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_GROUP
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's group key. Returns NULL_KEY if the target is an avatar (which means a workaround is required to get an avatar's active group).

symbols.name: OBJECT_GROUP_TAG
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get an avatar's active group tag/title. Returns an empty string if the target is not an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_HEALTH
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the current health value of an avatar or prim.

symbols.name: OBJECT_HOVER_HEIGHT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the dynamic hover height of an avatar (default is 0.0). Returns 0.0 if not an avatar or if no data is available; does not reflect the shape's 'Hover' slider.

symbols.name: OBJECT_LAST_OWNER_ID
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the key of the previous owner. For group-owned objects, returns the avatar who deeded it. Returns NULL_KEY for avatars, untransferred objects, or objects taken to inventory and re-rezzed.

symbols.name: OBJECT_LINK_NUMBER
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the index of the prim within its linkset, or 0 if unlinked.

symbols.name: OBJECT_LOCKED
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean, indicating if the object is locked.

symbols.name: OBJECT_MASS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the total mass (in kilograms) of the object's linkset.

symbols.name: OBJECT_MATERIAL
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the physics material of the object, returning an integer matching a PRIM_MATERIAL_* constant.

symbols.name: OBJECT_NAME
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's name, or the legacy name if the target is an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_OMEGA
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the rotational (angular) velocity of an object in radians per second.

symbols.name: OBJECT_OWNER
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the owner's key. If the target is an avatar, their own key is returned. If group-owned, it returns NULL_KEY.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PATHFINDING_TYPE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the pathfinding setting of an object in the region, returning an integer matching an OPT_* constant.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PERMS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the permissions of the object as five integers.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PERMS_COMBINED
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the permissions of the object combined with all of its inventory items as five integers.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PHANTOM
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating if phantom is enabled on the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar or attachment.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PHYSICS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating if physics is enabled on the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar or attachment.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PHYSICS_COST
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the physics cost of the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_POS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's position in region coordinates. For an avatar outside the region, the returned position is relative to the script's region.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PRIM_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim count of the object. Note that the script and target object must be owned by the same owner.

symbols.name: OBJECT_PRIM_EQUIVALENCE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim equivalence of the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_RENDER_WEIGHT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the render weight (Avatar Rendering Cost) of an avatar based on viewer reports. Returns 0 for objects, -1 if unknown, and is capped at 500,000.

symbols.name: OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL
symbols.summary: Scope flag used with llReturnObjectsByOwner to return all objects on the same parcel as the script owned by the specified owner. Requires the script owner to be an estate manager or the parcel owner.

symbols.name: OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL_OWNER
symbols.summary: Scope flag used with llReturnObjectsByOwner to return all objects owned by the specified owner that are located on parcels owned by the script's owner.

symbols.name: OBJECT_RETURN_REGION
symbols.summary: Scope flag used with llReturnObjectsByOwner to return all objects in the region owned by the specified owner. Only works if the script is owned by the estate owner or an estate manager.

symbols.name: OBJECT_REZZER_KEY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the key of the object or avatar that rezzed the target object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_REZ_TIME
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the timestamp of when the object was rezzed.

symbols.name: OBJECT_ROOT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the ID of the root prim. For an avatar, returns the root prim of the linkset they are sitting on (or the avatar's own ID if not sitting).

symbols.name: OBJECT_ROT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's rotation.

symbols.name: OBJECT_RUNNING_SCRIPT_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of running scripts attached to the target object or agent.

symbols.name: OBJECT_SCALE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the size (scale) of the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_SCRIPT_MEMORY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the allocated script memory (or its upper limit) in bytes for the object or agent. This value is recomputed every 10-20 seconds.

symbols.name: OBJECT_SCRIPT_TIME
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the average script CPU time (in seconds) used per frame. Reports a 30-minute average, or the average since entering the region if present for less than 30 minutes.

symbols.name: OBJECT_SELECT_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of agents/avatars actively selecting any link in the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_SERVER_COST
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the server cost of the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_SIT_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of agents sitting on any links in the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar.

symbols.name: OBJECT_STREAMING_COST
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the streaming (download) cost of the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TEMP_ATTACHED
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating whether the object is temporarily attached.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TEMP_ON_REZ
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating if temporary-on-rez is enabled for the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TEXT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the floating (hover) text displayed above the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TEXT_ALPHA
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the alpha value of the floating (hover) text displayed above the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TEXT_COLOR
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the color vector of the floating (hover) text displayed above the object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TOTAL_INVENTORY_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of inventory items inside the object. Requires the script and target object to share the same owner.

symbols.name: OBJECT_TOTAL_SCRIPT_COUNT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of scripts (both running and stopped) attached to the target object or agent.

symbols.name: OBJECT_UNKNOWN_DETAIL
symbols.summary: Flag returned by llGetObjectDetails when an invalid flag is requested.

symbols.name: OBJECT_VELOCITY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the velocity vector of the target object.

symbols.name: OBJECT_VOLUME_DETECT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean, indicating if the object is VolumeDetect.

symbols.name: OPT_AVATAR
symbols.summary: Returned for avatars.

symbols.name: OPT_CHARACTER
symbols.summary: Returned for pathfinding characters.

symbols.name: OPT_EXCLUSION_VOLUME
symbols.summary: Returned for exclusion volumes.

symbols.name: OPT_LEGACY_LINKSET
symbols.summary: Returned for movable obstacles, movable phantoms, physical, and volumedetect objects.

symbols.name: OPT_MATERIAL_VOLUME
symbols.summary: Returned for material volumes.

symbols.name: OPT_OTHER
symbols.summary: Returned for attachments, Linden trees, and grass.

symbols.name: OPT_STATIC_OBSTACLE
symbols.summary: Returned for static obstacles.

symbols.name: OPT_WALKABLE
symbols.summary: Returned for walkable objects.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_ALPHA
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the alpha for the face(s). Only impacts rendering when the alpha mode is set to PRIM_GLTF_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_ALPHA_MASK
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the alpha cutoff level on the face(s) when the alpha mode is set to mask.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_ALPHA_MODE
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the alpha mode on the face(s) to one of the valid blend modes.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_COLOR_FACTOR
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the tinting color (specified in linear RGB) used for the base color. Use llsRGB2Linear to convert colors from Blinn-Phong to PBR.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_DOUBLE_SIDED
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides. If set to TRUE, the texture on the face(s) will be rendered as double-sided.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_EMISSIVE_FACTOR
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the tint (specified in linear RGB) used for the emissive texture on the face(s).

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_METALLIC_FACTOR
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to adjust the metallic factor on the specified face(s) to a value between 0 and 1.

symbols.name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_ROUGHNESS_FACTOR
symbols.summary: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to adjust the roughness factor on the specified face(s) to a value between 0 and 1.

symbols.name: PARCEL_COUNT_GROUP
symbols.summary: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of objects not owned by the parcel owner but set to or owned by the parcel's group.

symbols.name: PARCEL_COUNT_OTHER
symbols.summary: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the land impact of all objects that are neither owned by the parcel owner nor set to or owned by the parcel's group.

symbols.name: PARCEL_COUNT_OWNER
symbols.summary: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of objects owned by the parcel owner.

symbols.name: PARCEL_COUNT_SELECTED
symbols.summary: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of all objects currently selected or sat on.

symbols.name: PARCEL_COUNT_TEMP
symbols.summary: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of temporary (temp-on-rez) objects.

symbols.name: PARCEL_COUNT_TOTAL
symbols.summary: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of all objects on the parcel(s), excluding temporary (temp-on-rez) objects.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_AREA
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel's area in square meters (sqm).

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_DESC
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the description of the parcel (up to 127 characters).

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_FLAGS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel flags set on this parcel (see llGetParcelFlags for listings and meanings).

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_GROUP
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel group's 36-character key.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_ID
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel's 36-character UUID/key.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_LANDING_LOOKAT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the lookat vector set for the landing point (teleport routing) on this parcel, if any.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_LANDING_POINT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the landing point vector set for this parcel, if any.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_NAME
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the name of the parcel (up to 63 characters).

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_OWNER
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel owner's 36-character key.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_PRIM_CAPACITY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the total prim capacity on this and all same-owner parcels, sim-wide (see llGetParcelMaxPrims for same-parcel-only and/or sim-wide reporting).

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_PRIM_USED
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the total prim usage on this and all same-owner parcels, sim-wide (see llGetParcelPrimCount to get prim counts by owner, group, or temporary status).

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_SCRIPT_DANGER
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to check if the script is in danger (due to restrictions that impact script execution) on the indicated parcel; see llScriptDanger.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_SEE_AVATARS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the 'See and chat with residents on this parcel' avatar visibility setting.

symbols.name: PARCEL_DETAILS_TP_ROUTING
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the teleport routing setting for this parcel (0 = TP_ROUTING_BLOCKED, 1 = TP_ROUTING_LANDINGP, 2 = TP_ROUTING_FREE; rules are only enforced if a landing point is set).

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_ALL_OBJECT_ENTRY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows all objects to enter.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_CREATE_GROUP_OBJECTS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if group members or scripts in group-deeded objects are allowed to create/rez objects on the parcel.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_CREATE_OBJECTS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows anyone to create objects.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_DAMAGE
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if damage is enabled on the parcel.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_FLY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if flying is allowed on the parcel.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_GROUP_OBJECT_ENTRY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts object entry to only group-owned and owner-owned objects.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_GROUP_SCRIPTS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows scripts owned by the parcel's group to run.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_LANDMARK
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows landmarks to be created.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_SCRIPTS
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if scripts (including outside scripts) are allowed to run on the parcel.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_TERRAFORM
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows anyone to terraform the land.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_LOCAL_SOUND_ONLY
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts spatialized sounds to the parcel (preventing outside sound from being heard inside).

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_RESTRICT_PUSHOBJECT
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts the use of llPushObject by non-owners (or non-group officers if group-owned).

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_ACCESS_GROUP
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel limits access to group members.

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_ACCESS_LIST
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel limits access to a specific list of residents (avatars).

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_BAN_LIST
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel uses a ban list (including restricting access based on payment information).

symbols.name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_LAND_PASS_LIST
symbols.summary: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts access via purchasable land passes (sold for L$).

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_AGENT
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to apply the specified media command to the designated agent only.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_AUTO_ALIGN
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to toggle or set the parcel media option 'Auto scale content'.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_DESC
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel media description.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_LOOP
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to start the media stream playing from the current frame and have it loop back to the beginning when it reaches the end.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_LOOP_SET
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel's media looping variable or loop duration (which may have functionality limitations; see VWR-19712).

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_PAUSE
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to pause the media stream on the current frame.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_PLAY
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to play the media stream from its current frame, stopping when the end is reached.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_SIZE
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel media pixel resolution.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_STOP
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to stop the media stream and rewind it to the first frame.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_TEXTURE
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel's media texture.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_TIME
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to jump to a specific timestamp in the media stream, specified in floating-point seconds.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_TYPE
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel media MIME type (e.g., 'text/html').

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_UNLOAD
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to completely unload the media and restore the face's original texture.

symbols.name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_URL
symbols.summary: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel's media URL.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_AGENT
symbols.summary: Option used with llSetParcelForSale to specify the agent ID authorized to buy the parcel. If none is set, any agent can purchase it.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_BAD_PARAMS
symbols.summary: Error code indicating the parameters provided to set the parcel sale information are invalid.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_INVALID_PRICE
symbols.summary: Error code indicating the specified parcel price is invalid (e.g., less than or equal to 0).

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_IN_ESCROW
symbols.summary: Error code indicating the parcel is in escrow and cannot be put up for sale.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_NO_PARCEL
symbols.summary: Error code indicating the parcel could not be found.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_NO_PERMISSIONS
symbols.summary: Error code indicating the script lacks the required permissions to set the parcel sale information.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_OBJECTS
symbols.summary: Option used with llSetParcelForSale. If set to TRUE, objects on the parcel are included in the sale.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_OK
symbols.summary: Status code indicating the parcel sale information was successfully set.

symbols.name: PARCEL_SALE_PRICE
symbols.summary: Option used with llSetParcelForSale to set the parcel price. If no authorized agent is set, the price must be greater than 0.

symbols.name: PASSIVE
symbols.summary: Identifies static or non-moving in-world objects (which do not consume active server resources). In llDetectedType(), indicates non-physical objects. In llSensor()/llSensorRepeat() filters, searches for non-physical, non-scripted, inactive, or non-moving physical objects.

symbols.name: PASS_ALWAYS
symbols.summary: Used with event-passing functions (e.g., llPassTouches, llPassCollisions) to ensure events are always passed from the child prim to the root prim, regardless of whether they are handled by child script handlers.

symbols.name: PASS_IF_NOT_HANDLED
symbols.summary: Used with event-passing functions (default behavior) to pass events from the child prim to the root prim only if there is no script handling the event in the child.

symbols.name: PASS_NEVER
symbols.summary: Used with event-passing functions to ensure events are never passed from the child prim to the root prim, regardless of whether they are handled by child script handlers.

symbols.name: PATROL_PAUSE_AT_WAYPOINTS

symbols.summary: GLTF alpha mode setting for PRIM_GLTF_BASE_COLOR. Renders the material with transparency (alpha blending) in linear color space. Transparency from the texture is multiplied by the material's opacity multiplier. Note: This mode can suffer from depth sorting and performance issues.

symbols.summary: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a ring and configure its shape properties.

symbols.name: PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT
