symbols.summary: Returns the surface coordinates (<s, t, 0.0>) where the prim was touched, specified by index. X and Y contain the horizontal (s) and vertical (t) face coordinates, typically in the interval [0.0, 1.0]. Returns TOUCH_INVALID_TEXCOORD if coordinates cannot be determined.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the detection information.

symbols.name: llDetectedTouchUV
symbols.summary: Returns the texture coordinates (<u, v, 0.0>) where the prim was touched, specified by index. X and Y contain the horizontal (u) and vertical (v) texture coordinates, typically in the interval [0.0, 1.0] (affected by repeats and rotation). Returns TOUCH_INVALID_TEXCOORD if coordinates cannot be determined.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the detection information.

symbols.name: llDetectedType
symbols.summary: Returns an integer bitfield representing the types (AGENT, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, or SCRIPTED) of the detected object or avatar specified by number. Returns 0 if number is not a valid index.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Index of the detection information.

symbols.name: llDetectedVel
symbols.summary: Returns the vector velocity of the detected object or avatar specified by number, or <0.0, 0.0, 0.0> if number is not a valid offset index.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Index of the detection information.

symbols.name: llDialog
symbols.signature: llDialog(key agent, string msg, list buttons, integer channel)
symbols.summary: Shows a dialog box on the screen of the specified agent, displaying msg along with up to 12 choice buttons. Clicking a button chats its label on channel. The chat originates at the object's position, but uses the agent's name and UUID, so it can be heard as long as the agent is still in the region.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the agent in the same region.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message to display in the dialog box.

parameters.name: buttons
parameters.description: A list of up to 12 strings representing button labels.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Output chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) where button clicks are chatted.

symbols.name: llDie
symbols.summary: Deletes the entire object containing the script (the object does not go to inventory). Use llBreakLink first to delete only a single prim.

symbols.name: llDumpList2String
symbols.summary: Returns a string that is the list src converted to a single string, with separator placed between each entry.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to convert.

parameters.name: separator
parameters.description: Separator string to place between list entries.

symbols.name: llEdgeOfWorld
symbols.summary: Checks if the border reached along the vector dir from the vector pos is the edge of the world (i.e., has no neighboring simulator). Returns TRUE if it hits the edge of the world, or FALSE if there is a neighboring simulator.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Direction vector.

symbols.name: llEjectFromLand
symbols.summary: Ejects the specified avatar from land/parcels owned by the object's owner (group or resident).

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llEmail
symbols.signature: llEmail(string address, string subject, string msg)
symbols.summary: Sends an email with the given destination address, subject, and body msg. The email will be sent from `{ll.GetKey()}@lsl.secondlife.com`. This can be used for script communication; see llGetNextEmail()

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Destination email address.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject of the email.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message body of the email.

symbols.name: llEscapeURL
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the escaped/encoded version of url, replacing spaces with '%20' and non-alphanumeric characters with their '%xx' hexadecimal UTF-8 equivalent.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Unescaped URL string to escape.

symbols.name: llEuler2Rot
symbols.summary: Returns the quaternion representation of the Euler angles (in radians) within vec.

parameters.name: vec
parameters.description: Vector of Euler angles to convert, in radians.

symbols.name: llEvade
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to evade target, attempting to hide from its pursuer if a hiding spot is available (i.e., no line of sight from the character's head to the pursuer's head, and no direct path on the navmesh).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to evade.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: No options currently available (should be empty list).

symbols.name: llExecCharacterCmd
symbols.summary: Sends a command (specified by command) to the pathing system with options. Currently only supports stopping pathfinding or making the character jump.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Pathfinding command to execute.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options for the command (e.g., jump height for CHARACTER_CMD_JUMP).

symbols.name: llFabs
symbols.summary: Returns the absolute (positive) value of val.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to convert.

symbols.name: llFindNotecardTextCount
symbols.signature: key llFindNotecardTextCount(string name, string pattern, list options)
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the number of matches of pattern in the notecard name. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression pattern to search for.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options to control the search (currently unused, should be []).

symbols.name: llFindNotecardTextSync
symbols.signature: list llFindNotecardTextSync(string name, string pattern, integer start, integer count, list options)
symbols.summary: Synchronously searches the notecard name in the region's cache for matches of pattern, without raising a dataserver event. Returns a strided list of the form [line, column, length, ...] with one stride per match, a list containing NAK if the notecard is not cached, or an empty list if there are no matches.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression pattern to search for.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first match to return.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of matches to return (if 0, returns the first 64 matches).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options to control the search (currently unused, should be []).

symbols.name: llFleeFrom
symbols.signature: llFleeFrom(vector position, float distance, list options)
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to keep the specified distance from the target position vector (within the region or adjacent regions).

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates from which to flee.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Distance in meters to keep from the position.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: No options currently available (should be empty list).

symbols.name: llFloor
symbols.summary: Returns val rounded toward negative infinity. In other words, returns the largest integer less than or equal to val.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to round down.

symbols.name: llForceMouselook
symbols.summary: Sets whether any avatar sitting on this prim is forced into mouselook mode. Setting mouselook to TRUE forces the mode; FALSE (default) allows the avatar to keep their current camera mode.

parameters.name: mouselook
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, forces a sitting avatar into mouselook; if FALSE, allows them to keep their current camera mode.

symbols.name: llFrand
symbols.summary: Returns a pseudo-random float in the range [0.0, mag) or (mag, 0.0] depending on the sign of mag. The value is inclusive of 0.0 but exclusive of mag.

parameters.name: mag
parameters.description: Float magnitude of the random range.

symbols.name: llGenerateKey
symbols.summary: Generates and returns a unique versioned UUID key (utilizing SHA-1 hashing). Due to being versioned, it will not return NULL_KEY; however, the exact UUID version is an implementation detail that should not be relied upon.

symbols.name: llGetAccel
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the acceleration of the object in the region's frame of reference.

symbols.name: llGetAgentInfo
symbols.summary: Returns an integer bitfield containing status information about the agent specified by id (such as AGENT_FLYING, AGENT_ATTACHMENTS, AGENT_SITTING, etc.).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetAgentLanguage
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the language code of the preferred interface language set by the avatar.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetAgentList
symbols.summary: Requests a list of avatar UUID keys for agents currently in the region, limited by scope. Returns a list of keys or a list containing an error message string.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope flag (AGENT_LIST_PARCEL, AGENT_LIST_PARCEL_OWNER, or AGENT_LIST_REGION) to filter the returned agents.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options to apply (currently unused).

symbols.name: llGetAgentSize
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the estimated bounding box size of the specified avatar, or ZERO_VECTOR if they are not in the same region.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetAlpha
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the Blinn-Phong alpha (transparency) of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, returns the mean average of all faces.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetAndResetTime
symbols.summary: Returns the elapsed script time in seconds as a float, then resets the script timer to zero.
caveats: Removed from the SLua API; migration requires a different pattern.

symbols.name: llGetAnimation
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the name of the currently playing locomotion animation for the specified avatar.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetAnimationList
symbols.summary: Returns a list of keys (UUIDs) representing all active animations currently playing on the specified avatar.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetAnimationOverride
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the name of the animation currently overriding the specified anim_state. Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS or PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION runtime permission.

parameters.name: anim_state
parameters.description: Animation state string to query.

symbols.name: llGetAttached
symbols.summary: Returns the integer attachment point (an ATTACH_* constant) that the object is attached to, or 0 if it is unattached or pending detachment.

symbols.name: llGetAttachedList
symbols.summary: Returns a list of object keys (UUIDs) worn by the specified avatar, in the order they were attached. HUDs are not included because they are neither public nor visible. Returns a list containing an error message string on failure.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetAttachedListFiltered
symbols.summary: Returns a list of object keys (UUIDs) worn by the specified avatar, in the order they were attached, filtered by options. Returns a list containing an error message string on failure.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options to filter the returned attachments.

symbols.name: llGetBoundingBox
symbols.summary: Returns the bounding box of object (including any linked prims) relative to its root prim in local coordinates, formatted as [ (vector) min_corner, (vector) max_corner ].

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar or prim in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetCameraAspect
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the camera's current aspect ratio (width/height) of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns 0.0 if permissions are not granted.

symbols.name: llGetCameraFOV
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the camera's current field of view (FOV) in radians of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns 0.0 if permissions are not granted.

symbols.name: llGetCameraPos
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the camera's current position in region coordinates of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns ZERO_VECTOR if permissions are not granted.

symbols.name: llGetCameraRot
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the camera's current orientation of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns ZERO_ROTATION if permissions are not granted.

symbols.name: llGetCenterOfMass
symbols.summary: Returns the vector position (in region coordinates) of the center of mass. Returns the individual child prim's center of mass if called from a child, or the entire linkset's center of mass if called from the root.

symbols.name: llGetClosestNavPoint
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the closest vector position on the navigation mesh (navmesh) to the specified point (expressed in region-local space), or an empty list if none is found. Configured using options.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: Position vector in region-local coordinates.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of GCNP_* flags and parameters to configure the search limits.

symbols.name: llGetColor
symbols.summary: Returns the Blinn-Phong RGB color vector of face (values between 0.0 and 1.0). If face is ALL_SIDES, returns the mean average of all faces.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetCreator
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the prim's original creator.

symbols.name: llGetDate
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the current date in the UTC time zone in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

symbols.name: llGetDayLength
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the number of seconds in the environmental day cycle applied to the current parcel.

symbols.name: llGetDayOffset
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the offset duration (in seconds) added to calculate the current environmental time on this parcel.

symbols.name: llGetDisplayName
symbols.summary: Returns the display name string of the avatar specified by id if they are in the region or cached; returns an empty string otherwise (use llRequestDisplayName if the avatar is absent).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region or otherwise known to the region.

symbols.name: llGetEnergy
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the remaining physics energy of the object as a percentage (0.0 to 1.0) of its maximum capacity.

symbols.name: llGetEnv
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the requested regional data specified by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the regional data to request (unrecognized strings return an empty string).

symbols.name: llGetEnvironment
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the current environment parameters for the parcel or region at pos, retrieved in the order specified by params.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates (X/Y determine the parcel, or region if X/Y are -1; Z determines the sky track altitude).

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of environmental attributes to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetExperienceDetails
symbols.summary: Returns a list of details for the specified experience_id, formatted as [string experience_name, key owner_id, key experience_id, integer state, string state_message, key group_id].

parameters.name: experience_id
parameters.description: UUID of the experience to query (can be NULL_KEY to retrieve details for the script's own experience).

symbols.name: llGetExperienceErrorMessage
symbols.summary: Returns a text description of the specified experience error code, or a description of XP_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ERROR if the error is invalid.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: XP_ERROR_* error code constant to translate.

symbols.name: llGetForce
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the constant force currently applied to the object (if the object is physical).

symbols.name: llGetFreeMemory
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the number of free bytes of memory currently available to the script.

symbols.name: llGetFreeURLs
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the number of available HTTP URLs (remaining for the owner if the object is attached, or for the region if unattached).

symbols.name: llGetGMTclock
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the time in seconds since midnight GMT (truncated to whole seconds).

symbols.name: llGetGameControlMode
symbols.summary: Returns a GAME_CONTROL_MODE_* integer indicating the current game-control mode for the avatar specified by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar whose game-controller state to query.

symbols.name: llGetGameControlModeAxes
symbols.summary: Returns a list of floats representing the modal axes for the current game-control mode of the avatar specified by id. Element count and index meanings vary by mode; use the GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_* constants as indices.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar whose game-controller state to query.

symbols.name: llGetGameControlModeButtons
symbols.summary: Returns a bitmask of the modal buttons currently active for the current game-control mode of the avatar specified by id. Bit meanings vary by mode; use the GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_* constants as masks.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar whose game-controller state to query.

symbols.name: llGetGeometricCenter
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the geometric center of the object relative to its root prim.

symbols.name: llGetHTTPHeader
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the value of the specified header associated with the HTTP request_id.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Unique key of the HTTP request.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Lowercase name of the HTTP header to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetHealth
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the current health of the avatar or object specified by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the agent or object to query.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryAcquireTime
symbols.summary: Returns the time when the item was placed in the prim's inventory, as a UTC timestamp string of the form "YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ"

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryCreator
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the creator of the specified inventory item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryDesc
symbols.summary: Returns the description string of the specified inventory item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryKey
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the specified inventory item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryName
symbols.summary: Returns the name of the inventory item of the specified type (INVENTORY_*) at the specified inventory index.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: INVENTORY_* type constant of the item.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the item of that type.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryNumber
symbols.summary: Returns the count of items of the specified type (INVENTORY_*) in the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: INVENTORY_* type constant to count.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryPermMask
symbols.summary: Returns the specified item's permission flags for the specified group.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to get.

symbols.name: llGetInventoryType
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the INVENTORY_* type of the named inventory item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: llGetKey
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the prim containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetLandOwnerAt
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the land owner at the vector pos, or NULL_KEY if the land is public.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates.

symbols.name: llGetLinkKey
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the linked prim or avatar specified by link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

symbols.name: llGetLinkMedia
symbols.signature: list llGetLinkMedia(integer link, integer face, list params)
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the media parameters of the specified face on the linked prim link, retrieved in the order requested by params.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_MEDIA_* property constants to retrieve values for.

symbols.name: llGetLinkName
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the name of the linked prim specified by link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

symbols.name: llGetLinkNumber
symbols.summary: Returns the integer link number of the prim containing the script (0 for unlinked, 1 for the root, and 2+ for children).

symbols.name: llGetLinkNumberOfSides
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the number of sides (faces) of the linked prim specified by link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

symbols.name: llGetLinkPrimitiveParams
symbols.summary: Returns a list of primitive parameters requested in params for the linked prim specified by link (equivalent to llGetPrimitiveParams).

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag to retrieve parameters from.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetLinkSitFlags
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the active sit flags currently set on the linked prim specified by link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

symbols.name: llGetListEntryType
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the variable type (TYPE_*) of the list entry at index in the list src.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llGetListLength
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total number of elements in the list src.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to measure.

symbols.name: llGetLocalPos
symbols.summary: Returns a position vector relative to the root prim. If called from the root prim, it returns the global region position (or the position relative to the attachment point if attached).

symbols.name: llGetLocalRot
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the local orientation of a child prim relative to the root prim, or the object's overall rotation if called from the root.

symbols.name: llGetMass
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the mass of the object (in lindograms). Returns the total linkset mass if called from the root, or the individual prim's mass if called from a child prim. Returns the wearer's mass if inside an attachment.

symbols.name: llGetMassMKS
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the mass of the object in kilograms. Functionally identical to llGetMass except for using MKS (metric) units.

symbols.name: llGetMaxScaleFactor
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the maximum scale factor that can be applied to the object via llScaleByFactor without violating size or linkability limits.

symbols.name: llGetMemoryLimit
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the maximum memory limit (in bytes) that the script is allowed to allocate.

symbols.name: llGetMinScaleFactor
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the minimum scale factor that can be applied to the object via llScaleByFactor without violating size limits.

symbols.name: llGetMoonDirection
symbols.summary: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the parcel's moon, taking altitude into account. Falls back to the region's moon direction if no custom parcel environment is set.

symbols.name: llGetMoonRotation
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the moon on the current parcel and altitude track. Falls back to the region's moon rotation if no custom parcel environment is set.

symbols.name: llGetNextEmail
symbols.summary:
Requests the next queued email via the email event. Emails must
1. Be sent to `{ll.GetKey()}@lsl.secondlife.com`
2. Be sent from the specified sender Address (or any address if blank)
3. Have the specified subject Subject (or any subject if blank)

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Sender email address filter, or "" for any address.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Email subject filter, or "" for any subject.

symbols.name: llGetNotecardLine
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the text of line in the notecard name. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event, which receives EOF if line is past the end of the notecard.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: Index of the line to read.

symbols.name: llGetNotecardLineSync
symbols.summary: Synchronously reads the text of line in the notecard name from the region's cache, without raising a dataserver event. Returns NAK if the notecard is not cached, or EOF if line is past the end of the notecard.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: Index of the line to read.

symbols.name: llGetNumberOfNotecardLines
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the number of lines in the notecard name. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

symbols.name: llGetNumberOfPrims
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total number of prims and seated avatars in the linkset containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetNumberOfSides
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total number of sides (faces) of the prim containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetObjectAnimationNames
symbols.summary: Returns a list of strings representing the names or UUIDs of all active animations currently playing on the object.

symbols.name: llGetObjectDesc
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the description of the specific prim containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetObjectDetails
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the requested parameters of the specified avatar or object id, retrieved in the order requested by params.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar or prim (in the same or adjacent regions) to query.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of OBJECT_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetObjectLinkKey
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the linked child prim specified by link within the linkset identified by object_id.

parameters.name: object_id
parameters.description: UUID of the target prim or linkset.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag of the prim to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetObjectMass
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the mass of the avatar or object specified by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar or object to query.

symbols.name: llGetObjectName
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the name of the specific prim containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetObjectPermMask
symbols.summary: Returns the script's object's permission flags for the specified group.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to get.

symbols.name: llGetObjectPrimCount
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total number of prims in the object containing the specified prim.

parameters.name: prim
parameters.description: UUID of the prim in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetOmega
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the physical rotation (angular velocity) of the object in radians per second.

symbols.name: llGetOwner
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the object's current owner.

symbols.name: llGetOwnerKey
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the owner of the prim specified by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the prim in the same region.

symbols.name: llGetParcelDetails
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the requested parcel details specified by params (retrieved in the same order) for the parcel at the vector pos.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates (only the X and Y components are used).

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of PARCEL_DETAILS_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetParcelFlags
symbols.summary: Returns an integer bitfield of parcel flags (PARCEL_FLAG_*) for the parcel at the position pos.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates (the Z component is ignored).

symbols.name: llGetParcelMaxPrims
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the maximum combined land impact (prim limit) allowed for objects on the parcel at pos, determined either for the single parcel or sim-wide based on sim_wide.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates (the Z component is ignored).

parameters.name: sim_wide
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, returns the combined land impact limit for all parcels owned by the parcel owner in the region; if FALSE, returns only the limit for the specified parcel.

symbols.name: llGetParcelMusicURL
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the parcel's streaming music (audio) URL. The object owner must also be the land owner (or share the same group deeding).

symbols.name: llGetParcelPrimCount
symbols.signature: integer llGetParcelPrimCount(vector pos, integer category, integer sim_wide)
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total land impact of objects on the parcel at pos in the specified category. If sim_wide is TRUE, returns combined usage for all regional parcels owned by the parcel owner; if FALSE, returns usage for only the specified parcel.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates (the Z component is ignored).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: PARCEL_COUNT_* category flag.

parameters.name: sim_wide
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, searches all parcels in the region owned by the targeted parcel's owner; if FALSE, searches only the specified parcel.

symbols.name: llGetParcelPrimOwners
symbols.summary: Returns a list of up to 100 strides (formatted as [key owner, integer land_impact]) representing owners of objects on the parcel at pos, sorted by owner key. Requires owner-like permissions for the parcel and the script owner's presence in the region.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates.

symbols.name: llGetPermissions
symbols.summary: Returns an integer bitfield representing the permissions (PERMISSION_*) currently granted to the script.

symbols.name: llGetPermissionsKey
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) of the avatar that last granted or declined permissions to the script, or NULL_KEY if the permissions request was ignored or cancelled.

symbols.name: llGetPhysicsMaterial
symbols.summary: Returns a list of the format [float gravity_multiplier, float restitution, float friction, float density] detailing the physical characteristics of the object.

symbols.name: llGetPos
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the current position of the object in region coordinates.

symbols.name: llGetPrimMediaParams
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the media parameters of the specified face, retrieved in the order requested by params. Returns an empty list if no media exists on the face.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_MEDIA_* property constants to retrieve values for.

symbols.name: llGetPrimitiveParams
symbols.summary: Returns a list of primitive attribute values matching the requested params list.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetRegionAgentCount
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the current number of avatars in the region.

symbols.name: llGetRegionCorner
symbols.summary: Returns a vector (in meters) representing the global grid coordinates of the south-west corner of the current region (Z component is always 0.0).

symbols.name: llGetRegionDayLength
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total number of seconds in the region-wide day cycle.

symbols.name: llGetRegionDayOffset
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the offset duration (in seconds) added to calculate the current environmental time for the region.

symbols.name: llGetRegionFPS
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the average region simulator frames per second (FPS).

symbols.name: llGetRegionFlags
symbols.summary: Returns an integer bitfield representing the region flags (REGION_FLAG_*) currently enabled for the region containing the object.

symbols.name: llGetRegionMoonDirection
symbols.summary: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the region's moon, taking altitude into account.

symbols.name: llGetRegionMoonRotation
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the moon at the region level, taking altitude track into account.

symbols.name: llGetRegionName
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the name of the current region.

symbols.name: llGetRegionSunDirection
symbols.summary: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the region's sun, taking altitude into account.

symbols.name: llGetRegionSunRotation
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the sun at the region level, taking altitude track into account.

symbols.name: llGetRegionTimeDilation
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the current physics time dilation of the region, ranging from 0.0 (full dilation / slow) to 1.0 (no dilation / real-world speed).

symbols.name: llGetRegionTimeOfDay
symbols.summary: Returns a float with subsecond precision representing the elapsed seconds since region environmental midnight or region uptime (whichever is smaller). If the region's sun position is fixed, returns region uptime.

symbols.name: llGetRenderMaterial
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the render material on face (returns the inventory name if it is in the prim's inventory, or its key UUID otherwise).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetRootPosition
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the position (in region coordinates) of the root prim of the linkset containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetRootRotation
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the orientation (relative to the region) of the root prim of the linkset containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetRot
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the prim's orientation relative to the region's axes.

symbols.name: llGetSPMaxMemory
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the maximum memory (in bytes) used by the script while the memory profiler was last active (only valid after using PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY).

symbols.name: llGetScale
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the physical scale (dimensions in meters) of the prim containing the script.

symbols.name: llGetScriptName
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the name of the script calling this function.

symbols.name: llGetScriptState
symbols.summary: Returns a boolean integer indicating whether the specified script in the prim's inventory is running (returns TRUE if running, FALSE otherwise).

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: llGetSimStats
symbols.summary: Returns a float containing the value of the requested region statistic specified by stat_type.

parameters.name: stat_type
parameters.description: SIM_STAT_* flag of the statistic to retrieve.

symbols.name: llGetSimulatorHostname
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the hostname of the server machine running the script (e.g., 'sim225.agni.lindenlab.com').

symbols.name: llGetStartParameter
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the start/rez parameter passed to the object on creation (returns 0 if rezzed by an agent).

symbols.name: llGetStartString
symbols.summary: Returns the initialization string passed to the object's root prim on rez with llRezObjectWithParams (via REZ_PARAM_STRING; returns an empty string if rezzed by an agent).

symbols.name: llGetStaticPath
symbols.signature: list llGetStaticPath(vector start_pos, vector end_pos, float radius, list params)
symbols.summary: Returns a list of position vectors representing pathfinding waypoints between start and end on the static navmesh for a character of the specified radius. Ignores movable obstacles and can be used in any region regardless of dynamic pathfinding status.

parameters.name: start_pos
parameters.description: Starting position vector.

parameters.name: end_pos
parameters.description: Target end position vector.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of the character path, between 0.125m and 5.0m.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list specifying the CHARACTER_TYPE parameter (defaults to CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE).

symbols.name: llGetStatus
symbols.summary: Returns a boolean integer indicating whether the specified status flag status is enabled for the object.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Single STATUS_* flag to check.

symbols.name: llGetSubString
symbols.signature: string llGetSubString(string src, integer start_index, integer end_index)
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the substring from src within the inclusive codepoint range start_index..end_index. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string. If start_index is greater than end_index, the substring is the excluded range.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to slice.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Starting codepoint index (inclusive). Supports negative indexing.

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Ending codepoint index (inclusive). Supports negative indexing.

symbols.name: llGetSunDirection
symbols.summary: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the parcel's sun, taking altitude into account. Falls back to the region's sun direction if no custom parcel environment is set.

symbols.name: llGetSunRotation
symbols.summary: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the sun on the current parcel and altitude track. Falls back to the region's sun rotation if no custom parcel environment is set.

symbols.name: llGetTexture
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the Blinn-Phong diffuse texture on face (returns the inventory name if it is a texture in the prim's inventory, or its key UUID otherwise).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetTextureOffset
symbols.summary: Returns a vector containing the texture offsets of face in the X (horizontal U) and Y (vertical V) components (Z is unused).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetTextureRot
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the texture rotation angle (in radians) on face.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetTextureScale
symbols.summary: Returns a vector containing the texture scales of face in the X and Y components (Z is unused).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: llGetTime
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the elapsed script time in seconds with subsecond precision (since the script started, was reset, or since the last call to llResetTime or llGetAndResetTime).

symbols.name: llGetTimeOfDay
symbols.summary: Returns a float with subsecond precision representing the elapsed seconds since parcel environmental midnight or region uptime (whichever is smaller). If the parcel's sun position is fixed, returns region uptime.

symbols.name: llGetTimestamp
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the current date and time in the UTC time zone formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp ('YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.ff..fZ').

symbols.name: llGetTorque
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the physical torque force currently acting on the object (if the object is physical).

symbols.name: llGetUnixTime
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the current Unix timestamp (the number of seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 Jan 1, 1970 UTC).

symbols.name: llGetUsedMemory
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the total number of bytes of memory currently used by the script (non-Mono scripts always return 16,384 bytes).

symbols.name: llGetUsername
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the unique username of the avatar specified by id if they are connected to the region or cached; returns an empty string otherwise (use llRequestUsername if the avatar is absent).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region or otherwise known to the region.

symbols.name: llGetVel
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the velocity of the object (in meters per second) relative to the global region coordinates. For physical objects, returns the velocity of its center of mass.

symbols.name: llGetVisualParams
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the values of the visual parameters requested in params for the agent specified by agentid.

parameters.name: agentid
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of visual parameter IDs or names to retrieve values for.

symbols.name: llGetWallclock
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the time in seconds since midnight Pacific Time (PST/PDT), which is equivalent to Second Life Time (SLT) truncated to whole seconds.

symbols.name: llGiveAgentInventory
symbols.signature: integer llGiveAgentInventory(key agent, string folder, list items, list options)
symbols.summary: Gives the specified inventory items to the agent as a new folder named folder, as permitted by the permissions system. Customizes the transfer using options.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the target agent in the same region.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Name of the destination folder to be created

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: The names of the items in the prim's inventory to transfer.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options to configure the inventory transfer.

symbols.name: llGiveInventory
symbols.summary: Gives the specified inventory item to the target, as permitted by the permissions system. The target can be any agent or an object located in the same region.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the target agent or prim.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory to transfer.

symbols.name: llGiveInventoryList
symbols.signature: llGiveInventoryList(key target, string folder, list items)
symbols.summary: Gives the list of inventory items to target as a new folder named folder. If target is an object, the items are passed directly into its inventory and no folder is created. The target must be an agent or an object in the same region.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the target agent or prim in the same region.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Name of the destination folder to be created (ignored if the target is an object).

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: The names of the items in the prim's inventory to transfer.

symbols.name: llGiveMoney
symbols.summary: Transfers the specified amount of L$ from the script owner to the destination avatar. Silently fails if the PERMISSION_DEBIT permission has not been granted. Returns 0 (use llTransferLindenDollars to match transactions to transaction_result events).

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: UUID of the destination avatar.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Number of L$ to transfer (must be greater than 0).

symbols.name: llGodLikeRezObject
symbols.summary: Rezzes an object directly from a UUID specified by id at the position pos, provided the owner has the god-bit set.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset UUID of the object to rez.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates where the object will be rezzed.

symbols.name: llGround
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the ground height directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: llGroundContour
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the ground contour direction (the direction with no change in elevation) directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: llGroundNormal
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the ground surface normal vector directly below the current position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: llGroundRepel
symbols.signature: llGroundRepel(float height, integer water, float tau)
symbols.summary: Critically damps the object's vertical motion to height (using critical damping timescale tau) if it is within height * 0.5 of the terrain (or water level if water is TRUE). Only works on physics-enabled objects; do not use with vehicles.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Target distance in meters above the ground or water.

parameters.name: water
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, damp relative to the higher of land and water; if FALSE, damp relative to land only.

parameters.name: tau
parameters.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the movement.

symbols.name: llGroundSlope
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the ground slope directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: llHMAC
symbols.signature: string llHMAC(string private_key, string msg, string algorithm)
symbols.summary: Returns a Base64-encoded HMAC hash of msg using the secret key private_key and the specified digest algorithm (md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512).

parameters.name: private_key
parameters.description: PEM-formatted secret key to use for the HMAC hash.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message string to be hashed.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use.

symbols.name: llHTTPRequest
symbols.signature: key llHTTPRequest(string url, list parameters, string body)
symbols.summary: Sends an HTTP request to the specified url containing body and configured via parameters. Raises an http_response event and returns a key query handle identifying the request.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Destination HTTP or HTTPS URL.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: A list of HTTP_* configuration flags and value pairs, or an HTTPRequestParams dictionary.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: String contents of the request body.

symbols.name: llHTTPResponse
symbols.signature: llHTTPResponse(key request_id, integer status, string body)
symbols.summary: Responds to the incoming HTTP request identified by request_id with the HTTP status code status and the payload body.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Unique key identifying the incoming HTTP request.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Integer HTTP status code (such as 200, 400, or 404) to respond with.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: String contents of the response body.

symbols.name: llHash
symbols.summary: Returns an integer representing the 32-bit hash value of the string val (returns 0 if the string is empty).

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: String to hash.

symbols.name: llInsertString
symbols.signature: string llInsertString(string dst, integer index, string src)
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of dst with src inserted at the given codepoint index.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Target destination string.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Codepoint index where insertion starts.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to insert.

symbols.name: llInstantMessage
symbols.summary: Sends an instant message containing msg to the agent identified by their key.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the destination agent.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to send.

symbols.name: llIntegerToBase64
symbols.summary: Returns an 8-character Base64 string representing the big-endian encoded value of number.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Integer number to encode.

symbols.name: llIsFriend
symbols.summary: Returns TRUE if agent_id and the owner of the script are friends, and FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: UUID of the agent to check.

symbols.name: llIsLinkGLTFMaterial
symbols.summary: Checks the specified face on the linked prim link. Returns TRUE if the face material is a PBR render material, or FALSE if it uses Blinn-Phong diffuse textures.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (or LINK_* flag) of the prim to inspect.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number (or ALL_SIDES) of the prim to inspect.

symbols.name: llJson2List
symbols.summary: Parses the JSON string src and returns a list representing its top-level elements.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: JSON string to parse.

symbols.name: llJsonGetValue
symbols.summary: Parses the JSON string json and returns the value found by traversing the specified path of specifiers as a string.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: JSON string to query.

parameters.name: specifiers
parameters.description: A list of key names or array indices specifying the path to the desired value.

symbols.name: llJsonSetValue
symbols.signature: string llJsonSetValue(string json, list specifiers, string value)
symbols.summary: Returns a new JSON string representing json with the target located at specifiers set to value. Supports JSON_APPEND to append elements. Writing JSON_DELETE deletes the target. Overwriting array bounds or setting non-array levels with array indices returns JSON_INVALID.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: Source JSON string to modify.

parameters.name: specifiers
parameters.description: A list of key names or array indices specifying the path to add, update, or delete.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value to set, or the JSON_DELETE constant to delete the targeted element.

symbols.name: llJsonValueType
symbols.summary: Parses the JSON string json and returns the JSON type constant (JSON_*) representing the value found at specifiers.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: JSON string containing the value to query.

parameters.name: specifiers
parameters.description: A list of key names or array indices specifying the path to the value.

symbols.name: llKey2Name
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the name of the prim or avatar specified by id. The target must be a valid, rezzed entity in the current region, otherwise an empty string is returned. Avatars return their legacy name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the target avatar or prim in the same region.

symbols.name: llKeyCountKeyValue
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction requesting the total count of keys in the experience data store. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

symbols.name: llKeysKeyValue
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction to retrieve count keys from the experience data store starting at the zero-based index first. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event. Fails with XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND if out of bounds.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Zero-based start index of the keys to retrieve.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of keys to retrieve.

symbols.name: llLinear2sRGB
symbols.summary: Returns a sRGB colorspace vector converted from the linear RGB colorspace argument.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color vector in the linear RGB space to convert.

symbols.name: llLinkAdjustSoundVolume
symbols.summary: Adjusts the volume of the currently playing sound attached to the linked prim link (has no effect on sounds started with llTriggerSound).

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag of the prim to adjust.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: llLinkParticleSystem
symbols.summary: Creates or updates a particle system on the linked prim link based on the list of rules. An empty list removes the particle system.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A list of particle system rules and data pairs [rule1, data1, ...], or a ParticleParams dictionary.

symbols.name: llLinkPlaySound
symbols.signature: llLinkPlaySound(integer link, string sound, float volume, integer flags)
symbols.summary: Plays the specified sound on the linked prim link (once or looping) at volume. Only one sound can be attached to a prim at a time; new attachments or calling llStopSound stops previous playback. Controlled by flags.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitwise flags (combination of SOUND_*) controlling the sound playback.

symbols.name: llLinkSetSoundQueueing
symbols.summary: Enables or disables sound queuing on the linked prim link. When set to TRUE, sounds will queue and play in sequence.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sound queuing is enabled; if FALSE, it is disabled.

symbols.name: llLinkSetSoundRadius
symbols.summary: Limits the audibility radius of attached and triggered scripted sounds to distance radius (in meters) around the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance in meters at which the sounds can be heard.

symbols.name: llLinkSitTarget
symbols.signature: llLinkSitTarget(integer link, vector offset, rotation rot)
symbols.summary: Sets the sit target position (offset) and orientation (rot) for the linked prim link, relative to the prim's own position and rotation. Clear by setting offset to <0.0, 0.0, 0.0>.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset position vector in local prim coordinates.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Rotation relative to the prim's rotation.

symbols.name: llLinkStopSound
symbols.summary: Stops the playback of any currently playing attached sound on the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataAvailable
symbols.summary: Returns the number of bytes remaining in the linkset datastore.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataCountFound
symbols.summary: Returns the number of keys in the linkset datastore that match the regular expression pattern.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression (regex) matching the keys to count.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataCountKeys
symbols.summary: Returns the number of keys in the linkset datastore.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataDelete
symbols.summary: Deletes the unprotected key name from the linkset datastore, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the key to delete.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataDeleteFound
symbols.summary: Deletes all keys in the linkset datastore that match the regular expression pattern, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Protected keys are only deleted if their passphrase matches pass. Returns a list [num_deleted, num_failed_protected].

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression (regex) matching the keys to delete.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Optional passphrase required to delete matching protected keys.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataDeleteProtected
symbols.summary: Deletes the protected key name from the linkset datastore using the passphrase pass, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the protected key to delete.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Passphrase required to delete the protected key.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataFindKeys
symbols.signature: list llLinksetDataFindKeys(string pattern, integer start, integer count)
symbols.summary: Returns an alphabetically sorted list of up to count keys from the linkset datastore that match the regular expression pattern, starting at index start (returns all matching keys if count < 1).

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression (regex) matching the keys to return.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first matching key to return.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of keys to return (or less than 1 to retrieve all matching keys).

symbols.name: llLinksetDataListKeys
symbols.summary: Returns an alphabetically sorted list of up to count keys from the linkset datastore, starting at index start (returns all keys if count < 1).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first key to return.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of keys to return (or less than 1 to retrieve all keys).

symbols.name: llLinksetDataRead
symbols.summary: Returns the value of the unprotected key name from the linkset datastore. Returns an empty string if the key is not found or is protected.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the key to read.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataReadProtected
symbols.summary: Returns the value of the protected key name from the linkset datastore using the passphrase pass. Returns an empty string if the key is not found or pass does not match.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the protected key to read.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Passphrase required to read the protected key.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataReset
symbols.summary: Deletes all keys from the linkset datastore, triggering a linkset_data event.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataWrite
symbols.summary: Creates or updates the unprotected key name in the linkset datastore with value, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the key to write.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write to the key (an empty string deletes the key).

symbols.name: llLinksetDataWriteProtected
symbols.signature: integer llLinksetDataWriteProtected(string name, string value, string pass)
symbols.summary: Creates or updates the protected key name in the linkset datastore with value using the passphrase pass, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the protected key to write.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write to the key (an empty string deletes the key).

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Passphrase used to protect or update the key.

symbols.name: llList2CSV
symbols.summary: Returns a string of comma-separated values taken in order from the list src.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to convert.

symbols.name: llList2Float
symbols.summary: Returns the float value at index in the list src. Returns 0.0 if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llList2Integer
symbols.summary: Returns the integer value at index in the list src. Returns 0 if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llList2Json
symbols.summary: Converts the list values into a JSON string of the specified type (either a JSON_ARRAY or a JSON_OBJECT). Returns JSON_INVALID if an error is encountered.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: JSON target type (JSON_ARRAY or JSON_OBJECT).

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: List of values to serialize.

symbols.name: llList2Key
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) value at index in the list src. Returns a null string/key if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llList2List
symbols.signature: list llList2List(list src, integer start_index, integer end_index)
symbols.summary: Returns a new list containing the subset of entries from src within the inclusive range specified by the start and end indices. Negative indices count backward from the end.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to slice.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive).

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive).

symbols.name: llList2ListSlice
symbols.signature: list llList2ListSlice(list src, integer start_index, integer end_index, integer stride, integer slice_index)
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the slice_index'th element of every stride within the inclusive range from start to end in the strided list src. Stride must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source strided list.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive).

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive).

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

parameters.name: slice_index
parameters.description: Zero-based element index within each stride to extract (negatives count backward from the end of the stride).

symbols.name: llList2ListStrided
symbols.signature: list llList2ListStrided(list src, integer start_index, integer end_index, integer stride)
symbols.summary: Returns a new list containing the first element of every stride in the strided list src within the inclusive range from start to end.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source strided list.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive).

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive).

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

symbols.name: llList2Rot
symbols.summary: Returns the rotation value at index in the list src. Returns ZERO_ROTATION if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llList2String
symbols.summary: Returns the string value at index in the list src. Returns an empty string if the index is out of bounds.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llList2Vector
symbols.summary: Returns the vector value at index in the list src. Returns ZERO_VECTOR if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: llListFindList
symbols.summary: Returns the integer index of the first instance of list test within the list src (returns -1 if not found).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to search within.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: List elements to search for.

symbols.name: llListFindListNext
symbols.signature: integer llListFindListNext(list src, list test, integer instance)
symbols.summary: Returns the integer index of the specified instance of list test within the list src (returns -1 if not found).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to search within.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: List elements to search for.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Zero-based occurrence index of the match to find.

symbols.name: llListFindStrided
symbols.signature: integer llListFindStrided(list src, list test, integer start_index, integer end_index, integer stride)
symbols.summary: Returns the integer index of the first instance of list test in the strided list src within the range from start to end (stepping through by stride). Returns -1 if not found.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to search within.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: List elements to search for.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index of the range to search.

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index of the range to search.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per stride in the list.

symbols.name: llListInsertList
symbols.signature: list llListInsertList(list dest, list src, integer start)
symbols.summary: Returns a new list containing all elements of dest with the elements of src inserted starting at index start. Does not modify dest itself.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Target destination list.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to insert.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based index where insertion begins.

symbols.name: llListRandomize
symbols.summary: Returns a randomized copy of the list src by blocks of size stride. If the list length is not perfectly divisible by stride, no randomization occurs.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to randomize.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Size of each randomized block (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

symbols.name: llListReplaceList
symbols.signature: list llListReplaceList(list dest, list src, integer start_index, integer end_index)
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the list dest with the inclusive range from start to end removed, and the elements of src inserted in its place at start.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Target destination list.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to insert.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive) of the replaced range.

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive) of the replaced range.

symbols.name: llListSort
symbols.signature: list llListSort(list src, integer stride, integer ascending)
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the list src, sorted into blocks of stride in ascending order (if ascending is TRUE) or descending order (if FALSE). Only works if the first entry of each block shares the same datatype.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to be sorted.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per block/stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sorts in ascending order; if FALSE, sorts in descending order.

symbols.name: llListSortStrided
symbols.signature: list llListSortStrided(list src, integer stride, integer stride_index, integer ascending)
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the list src sorted into blocks of stride by the element at stride_index in each block. Sorted in ascending order (if ascending is TRUE) or descending order (if FALSE).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to be sorted.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per block/stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

parameters.name: stride_index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the element within each stride to use as the sort key (negatives count backward from the end of the stride).

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sorts in ascending order; if FALSE, sorts in descending order.

symbols.name: llListStatistics
symbols.summary: Returns the numeric result of the statistical aggregate function operation (a LIST_STAT_* constant) on the numeric list src.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: LIST_STAT_* constant of the statistical operation to perform.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List of numbers to analyze.

symbols.name: llListen
symbols.signature: integer llListen(integer channel, string name, key id, string msg)
symbols.summary: Creates a listener on channel from name and id for msg. Returns an integer listener handle used to control or remove the listener. Empty strings or NULL_KEY filters do not filter on those parameters.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to listen on. Exact range is -2147483648 to 2147483647.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specific prim name or agent legacy name to filter by (or empty string for no filter).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Specific agent or prim UUID to filter by (or NULL_KEY for no filter).

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Specific chat message string to filter by (or empty string for no filter).

symbols.name: llListenControl
symbols.summary: Enables or disables the listener specified by the integer handle. If active is TRUE, the listener is activated; if FALSE, it is deactivated.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Integer listener handle returned by llListen.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, activates the listener; if FALSE, deactivates it.

symbols.name: llListenRemove
symbols.summary: Completely removes the listener specified by the integer handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Integer listener handle returned by llListen to remove.

symbols.name: llLoadURL
symbols.signature: llLoadURL(key avatar, string message, string url)
symbols.summary: Shows a dialog box displaying message to the avatar avatar offering to open the specified url. Clicking yes launches the URL in their default web browser.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Text message to display in the dialog box.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Web URL to open.

symbols.name: llLog
symbols.summary: Returns natural (base e) logarithm of val. If negative, return 0.0.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to compute the logarithm of.

symbols.name: llLog10
symbols.summary: Returns base-10 (common) logarithm of val. If negative, return 0.0.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to compute the logarithm of.

symbols.name: llLookAt
symbols.signature: llLookAt(vector target, float strength, float damping)
symbols.summary: Causes the object to orient its positive Z-axis (up axis) toward the target vector, keeping its positive X-axis (forward axis) below the horizon. Tracks target until llStopLookAt is called or strength is set to 0.0.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target position vector in region coordinates to look at.

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: Force of rotation (0.0 cancels the tracking; values around half the object's mass are typical).

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the orientation.

symbols.name: llLoopSound
symbols.summary: Plays the attached sound looping indefinitely at the specified volume. Only one sound can be attached to a prim at a time; new loops adjust the volume of the currently playing sound without restarting it.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: llLoopSoundMaster
symbols.summary: Plays the attached sound looping indefinitely at the specified volume and declares it a Sync Master, forcing slave sounds to synchronize with it.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: llLoopSoundSlave
symbols.summary: Plays the attached sound looping indefinitely at the specified volume, synchronized to the most audible active Sync Master in range.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: llMD5String
symbols.summary: Returns a string of 32 hex characters representing the MD5 checksum of src salted with nonce (formatted as ':' + nonce).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to hash.

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: Nonce string used as a salt.

symbols.name: llMakeExplosion
symbols.signature: llMakeExplosion(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, string texture, vector offset)
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Generates a circular explosion of particles. Use llParticleSystem instead.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position (expressed in local coordinates; completely ignored by the system).

symbols.name: llMakeFire
symbols.signature: llMakeFire(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, string texture, vector offset)
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Generates fire-like particles. Use llParticleSystem instead.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position (expressed in local coordinates; completely ignored by the system).

symbols.name: llMakeFountain
symbols.signature: llMakeFountain(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, integer bounce, string texture, vector offset, float bounce_offset)
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Generates a fountain of particles. Use llParticleSystem instead.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position (expressed in local coordinates; completely ignored by the system).

symbols.name: llMakeSmoke
symbols.signature: llMakeSmoke(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, string texture, vector offset)
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Generates smoke-like particles. Use llParticleSystem instead.

parameters.name: texture
