symbols.summary: Plays the specified sound once at volume, centered at the object but not attached, restricted to the axis-aligned bounding box defined by the coordinates top_north_east and bottom_south_west.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

parameters.name: top_north_east
parameters.description: Top-north-east boundary position vector in region coordinates.

parameters.name: bottom_south_west
parameters.description: Bottom-south-west boundary position vector in region coordinates.

symbols.name: llUnSit
symbols.summary: Forces the agent specified by id to stand up if they are sitting on the object containing the script, or are currently over land owned by the object's owner.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to unsit.

symbols.name: llUnescapeURL
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the unescaped/decoded version of url, replacing '%20' with spaces and decoding raw UTF-8 characters.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Escaped URL string to decode.

symbols.name: llUpdateCharacter
symbols.summary: Updates settings for a pathfinding character using the parameters specified in options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of key-value pairs specifying the character's new configuration options (takes same constants as llCreateCharacter).

symbols.name: llUpdateKeyValue
symbols.signature: key llUpdateKeyValue(string k, string v, integer checked, string original_value)
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction to update the key k to value v inside the experience datastore. If checked is TRUE, the update fails with XP_ERROR_RETRY_UPDATE unless the existing value matches original_value.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Key of the key-value pair to update.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: New value for the key-value pair.

parameters.name: checked
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, requires the existing value to match original_value to complete the update; if FALSE, creates the key if needed.

parameters.name: original_value
parameters.description: String value to compare against the existing value in the datastore.

symbols.name: llVecDist
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the undirected, non-negative distance between vectors vec_a and vec_b.

parameters.name: vec_a
parameters.description: First vector.

parameters.name: vec_b
parameters.description: Second vector.

symbols.name: llVecMag
symbols.summary: Returns the magnitude (geometric length) of vec.

parameters.name: vec
parameters.description: Vector to evaluate.

symbols.name: llVecNorm
symbols.summary: Returns the normalized unit vector pointing the same direction as vec. If <0, 0, 0>, return <0, 0, 0>.

parameters.name: vec
parameters.description: Vector to normalize.

symbols.name: llVerifyRSA
symbols.signature: integer llVerifyRSA(string public_key, string msg, string signature, string algorithm)
symbols.summary: Returns TRUE if the Base64-formatted signature is verified as valid for the message msg when using the digest algorithm and public_key. Returns FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: public_key
parameters.description: PEM-formatted public key to use for signature verification.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message string that was signed.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: Base64-encoded signature to verify.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use.

symbols.name: llVolumeDetect
symbols.summary: If detect is TRUE, enables VolumeDetect (object becomes phantom and physical objects/avatars can pass through it). Triggers collision_start on initial intersection and collision_end when intersection stops (standard collision events are suppressed while intersecting).

parameters.name: detect
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables VolumeDetect; if FALSE (default), disables it.

symbols.name: llWanderWithin
symbols.signature: llWanderWithin(vector origin, vector dist, list options)
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to wander around a central coordinate origin, restricted within the bounding distance limits of dist and configured by options.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Center coordinate position vector to wander about.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: A vector specifying the maximum distance limits (half-extents) along each world-aligned axis from the origin.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of WANDER_* flags and parameters to configure the wander behavior.

symbols.name: llWater
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the water height directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: llWhisper
symbols.summary: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("whisper_range"), which is 10m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to whisper the message on.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to broadcast.

symbols.name: llWind
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the wind velocity at the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: llWorldPosToHUD
symbols.summary: Returns the local position vector that places the center of the HUD object directly over the world coordinate world_pos as viewed by the current camera. Requires the PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA runtime permission.

parameters.name: world_pos
parameters.description: World-frame position vector to project into HUD space.

symbols.name: llXorBase64
symbols.summary: Correctly performs a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2, returning the result as a Base64 string. The string str2 repeats if it is shorter than str1.

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: First Base64 string.

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

symbols.name: llXorBase64Strings
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llXorBase64 instead). Retained for backwards compatibility. Incorrectly performs a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2.

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: First Base64 string.

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

symbols.name: llXorBase64StringsCorrect
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llXorBase64 instead). Correctly performs (unless nulls are present) a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2.

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: First Base64 string.

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

symbols.name: llsRGB2Linear
symbols.summary: Returns a linear RGB colorspace vector converted from the sRGB colorspace argument.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color vector in the sRGB colorspace to convert.

symbols.name: money
symbols.summary: Triggered when a resident specified by id pays an amount of Linden dollars (L$) to the prim.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the paying resident.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Quantity of L$ paid to the prim.

symbols.name: moving_end
symbols.summary: Triggered whenever the physical or moving object containing the script stops moving.

symbols.name: moving_start
symbols.summary: Triggered whenever the physical or moving object containing the script starts moving.

symbols.name: no_sensor
symbols.summary: Triggered when active sensors (from llSensor or llSensorRepeat) complete a scan without finding any matching targets.

symbols.name: not_at_rot_target
symbols.summary: Triggered continuously while the object's rotation is outside the leeway angle of targets set via llRotTarget.

symbols.name: not_at_target
symbols.summary: Triggered continuously while the object's position has not yet reached the range of targets set via llTarget.

symbols.name: object_rez
symbols.summary: Triggered when this object successfully rezzes another object from its inventory. Passes the key (UUID) id of the newly rezzed object.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the newly rezzed object.

symbols.name: on_damage
symbols.summary: Triggered when damage has been inflicted on an avatar or task, but before it is applied or distributed. Collision detected functions (llDetected*), llDetectedDamage, and llAdjustDamage are available. Passes num_detected, representing the number of pending damage events.

parameters.name: num_detected
parameters.description: Number of pending damage events.

symbols.name: on_death
symbols.summary: Triggered on all worn attachments when the wearing avatar's health reaches 0.

symbols.name: on_rez
symbols.summary: Triggered when the object is rezzed into the world (by a script or user). Passes start_param from the rezzing call (or 0 if rezzed from inventory). Also triggers on attachments during login or when attached from inventory.

parameters.name: start_param
parameters.description: Integer start parameter passed from the rezzing call.

symbols.name: path_update
symbols.summary: Triggered to inform the script of changes or failures in the pathfinding character's status.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Path update status or failure code constant (PU_* flag).

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: Reserved parameter (currently unused).

symbols.name: quaternion
symbols.summary: Quaternion type is a left over from way back when LSL was created. It was later renamed to <rotation> to make it more user friendly, but it appears someone forgot to remove it ;-)

symbols.name: remote_data
symbols.signature: remote_data(integer event_type, key channel, key message_id, string sender, integer idata, string sdata)
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Triggered by incoming XML-RPC calls, passing event_type, channel, message_id, sender, idata, and sdata.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Integer constant representing the type of XML-RPC event.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: XML-RPC channel ID key.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: XML-RPC message ID key.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: XML-RPC sender string.

parameters.name: idata
parameters.description: Payload integer data.

parameters.name: sdata
parameters.description: Payload string data.

symbols.name: rotation
symbols.summary:
Rotation type is one of several ways to represent an orientation in 3D.
It is a mathematical object called a quaternion. You can think of a quaternion as four numbers (x, y, z, w), three of which represent the direction an object is facing and a fourth that represents the object's banking left or right around that direction.

symbols.name: run_time_permissions
symbols.summary: Triggered when an agent grants or denies runtime permissions requested by llRequestPermissions. Passes the active integer permissions bitfield perm (returns 0 if no permissions are currently granted).

parameters.name: perm
parameters.description: Bitfield of currently granted permissions (PERMISSION_* flags).

symbols.name: sensor
symbols.summary: Triggered when objects matching constraints of llSensor or llSensorRepeat are successfully detected. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected targets.

parameters.name: num_detected
parameters.description: Total number of detected targets found (usable with llDetected* functions).

symbols.name: state_entry
symbols.summary: Triggered immediately whenever a new state is entered (including at script start). It is always the first event handled.
caveats: Removed from the SLua API; migration requires a different pattern.

symbols.name: state_exit
symbols.summary: Triggered when the state command is used to transition out of the current state. Handled before entering the new state's state_entry.
caveats: Removed from the SLua API; migration requires a different pattern.

symbols.name: string
symbols.summary:
Text data.
The editor accepts UTF-8 encoded text.

symbols.name: timer
symbols.summary: Triggered at regular periodic intervals configured by llSetTimerEvent.

symbols.name: touch
symbols.summary: Triggered continuously while an avatar touches the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

parameters.name: num_detected
parameters.description: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

symbols.name: touch_end
symbols.summary: Triggered when an avatar stops touching the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

parameters.name: num_detected
parameters.description: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

symbols.name: touch_start
symbols.summary: Triggered when an avatar first touches the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

parameters.name: num_detected
parameters.description: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

symbols.name: transaction_result
symbols.signature: transaction_result(key id, integer success, string data)
symbols.summary: Triggered when an asynchronous L$ transfer (such as llTransferLindenDollars) is completed. Passes transaction info id, success status, and CSV or error data.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Key matching the handle returned by the initiating llTransfer* function.

parameters.name: success
parameters.description: Boolean. TRUE if the L$ transfer succeeded, FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Contains a CSV string of transaction info on success, or an error string on failure.

symbols.name: vector
symbols.summary:
A vector is a data type that contains a set of three float values.
Vectors are used to represent colors (RGB), positions, and directions/velocities.
